name: voice-lab
description: Local multi-speaker audio studio: script to mastered podcast with Kokoro voices, a Whisper listening check on every line, and word-timed transcription.
author: zorai

whisper_model.label: Whisper model
whisper_model.description: faster-whisper size used for the listening check and transcription: tiny, base, small, medium, large-v3

device.label: Listening check device
device.description: auto uses the GPU when it can and falls back to the CPU; or set cuda or cpu

max_wer.label: Retry above word error rate
max_wer.description: A line is regenerated when Whisper hears more than this share of words wrong (0.1 = 10%)

run.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py check
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py setup
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py voices
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py preview
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py render
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py transcribe
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py load
uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py parse

check.description: Show whether ffmpeg, the Kokoro voices, Whisper and the GPU are ready

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py check --format markdown

render.description: Render a project to a mastered MP3/WAV with a listening check on every line. Add --project <name> --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py render

transcribe.description: Transcribe an audio or video file with word timings and subtitles. Add --path <file> --wait

python.command: uv run --quiet --no-project --python 3.12 --with-requirements requirements.txt python scripts/voice_lab.py transcribe

commands.title: Turn a topic into an audio briefing
commands.prompt: Use the voice-lab plugin to write a two-host audio briefing about {{topic}}, save it as a Voice Lab project and render it. Report the listening-check results.

inputs.label: What should it cover?
inputs.placeholder: this thread, the latest release notes, a paper
